title: Pragmatic Curiosity: A Unified Framework for Hybrid Learning and Optimization via Active Inference
abstract: arXiv:2602.06104v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many engineering and scientific workflows rely on expensive black-box evaluations, requiring sequential decisions that must both improve task performance and reduce uncertainty. Bayesian optimization (BO) and Bayesian experimental design (BED) provide powerful but largely separate treatments of goal-directed optimization and information-seeking experimentation, leaving limited guidance for hybrid settings in which learning and optimization are intrinsically coupled. We propose Pragmatic Curiosity (PraC), a unified framework for hybrid learning and optimization via active inference. PraC evaluates candidate queries by trading information gain about a task-relevant latent symbol against an expected regret-based potential over outcomes. This formulation foregrounds three operational design choices: which latent quantity should be clarified, how task value is encoded as regret, and how strongly information gain should be exchanged agains

translated_title: 实用好奇心：基于主动推理的混合学习与优化的统一框架
translated_abstract: 许多工程和科学工作流程依赖于昂贵的黑盒评估，需要做出既能提升任务性能又能降低不确定性的序贯决策。贝叶斯优化（BO）和贝叶斯实验设计（BED）分别为目标导向的优化和信息探索实验提供了强大但在很大程度上相互独立的方法，对于学习与优化内在耦合的混合场景，现有方法缺乏足够的指导。我们提出了实用好奇心，这是一个通过主动推理实现混合学习与优化的统一框架。PraC 通过权衡关于任务相关潜在符号的信息增益与基于预期遗憾的结果潜力来评估候选查询。这一表述突出了三个操作层面的设计选择：应当澄清哪个潜在量、任务价值如何被编码为遗憾，以及信息增益应当以多大强度进行交换（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了实用好奇心（PraC）框架，通过主动推理将贝叶斯优化与贝叶斯实验设计统一起来，以信息增益与预期遗憾之间的权衡来指导混合学习与优化场景中的序贯决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Pragmatic Curiosity (PraC), a unified active-inference framework that bridges Bayesian optimization and Bayesian experimental design by trading information gain against expected regret to guide sequential decisions in hybrid learning and optimization.
